name: midi-lab
description: Original multitrack MIDI composition, emotional loops, fractural textures, MIDI audits, and tempo-aware Logic Pro effects advice using the complete MIDI Lab 4.2 Python engine.

interface.longDescription: Create original multi-track MIDI songs, switch between minimalist and fractured arrangements, analyze MIDI quality, and get per-track effects recommendations. Includes the original MIDI Lab 3.0–4.2 source and a local Python MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Cook an original 3-minute bittersweet synth-pop MIDI with separate Logic Pro tracks.
Make a minimalist loop that evolves emotionally without drum fills.
Analyze my MIDI and suggest tape-bliss effects and dotted-eighth delays.
